for_the_h3a_signature_card: Two axis defects are ROUTED, not waived (AX-02 sh009, AX-04 sh085), and two scale statements are routed with them (sh049/sh050, sh067). All four are one-field text corrections in files that are otherwise final. The auto-rerun budget is 0, so they are being put in front of the user rather than retried. They block p7 prompt for grp005, grp019, grp026 and grp032 only - they do NOT block whitebox staging or the g6w export, because they touch composition/blocking text, not blocking_map routes or camera positions.

The H3S White Rabbit ruling and the frozen shot_list do not read identically. The ruling says the gloves and fan are carried in his mouth with the quadruped gait locked; shot_list stages him putting the gloves down between his forefeet in sh028 and holding gloves and fan in his forepaws in sh074 - both while sitting back on his haunches with his forelegs free. The reading applied throughout the plan: mouth whenever he is moving on four legs (sh027, sh031, sh073, sh077), forepaws only while sitting back (sh028, sh029, sh074, sh076). Nothing in shot_list was changed. If the user meant mouth in literally every shot, sh028's watch business and sh074's forepaw hold both need re-staging, which is a shot_list change and a gate decision.

The per-shot soiling and wetness chain in costume_states is this station's own increment - no upstream file specifies any dirt, damage or wetness anywhere in ep01. It is deliberately light and monotone (pale dry earth from sh013, leaf fragments from sh026, gilding flakes from sh065, tear-marked face from sh055, wet from sh071, soaked head to foot from sh094) and exists so that ninety-odd independently generated clips do not each invent their own. If art direction would rather Alice stay spotless through the dream, saying so now costs nothing and saying so after p7 costs a re-prompt of forty groups.

One binding gap was closed in this plan that is written nowhere in the shot design: the White Rabbit must take the gloves BACK INTO HIS MOUTH in sh031 before he drops onto four legs and rounds the corner. He put them down in sh028; without the pick-up they are abandoned in the S04 passage and the gloves he carries in sh073 come from nowhere.

The little door is open in S07 (sh067) and 'shut again' in S09 (sh090) with nothing on screen closing it - Carroll's own gap, carried by the frozen screenplay. It is invisible because the low curtain hangs across the door for all twenty-one S08 shots and the door is in frame in none of them. Recorded, with a binding instruction that no S08 prompt may show the door open behind her. No action requested; noted so it is not re-opened later as a new finding.

Everything else is signable as it stands: 36/36 boundaries covered, anchor 'none' on every one, no continuity_ref anywhere in the project, no costume change in the episode, every prop hand-off traced to bible/props.json, and one time_of_day (early_afternoon) with no day/night jump - the single clock step backwards is the declared flash-forward FF-ep01-open.
